Ah, we aren’t set up to manually combine orders, since plants typically ship separately in their own boxes.
Different nurseries have different inventory, so multi-plant orders may ship from more than one location. We can’t manually combine shipments, since plants usually ship in separate boxes.
Sometimes multiple plants will ship together in a box when it makes sense, but that’s automatic and not something we can guarantee in advance.
Standard shipping is still on us, and you’ll get tracking for each shipment - one link or multiple, depending on how it ships.
